g.text: One assembly or the defined small initial set
used for startup verification under the local process

text.tspan: SPI may evaluate volume / height / area

g.text: PASS → reflow and inspect as required
Abnormal / uncertain evidence at any startup gate
Do not continue with unresolved evidence.
Correct the controlled board, material, program, recipe,
or process setup that caused the abnormal result.
Repeat downstream checks invalidated by the change
when required by the controlled process.
Return to the affected gate; never jump directly to normal production.
